description: This file defines a Flutter screen widget called SizeGuideScreen which displays a size guide image. It includes state management for toggling size units but in its current form only displays a static image via the BuyFullKit widget.

classes.name: SizeGuideScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the size guide screen in the app.

classes.name: _SizeGuideScreenState
classes.description: State class for SizeGuideScreen, managing the display state.

methods.name: updateSizes
methods.description: Toggles the boolean _isShowCentimetersSize to switch between size units.
